steps.name: Merry
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Faster... I've got to get faster.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Whoa—

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: *Cough*, *cough* *cough*... Ouch...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Ah, shoot! My snowboard... Looks like it's still good. Okay, please, hang in there a little longer. There's a car rental place just down the hill... As long as I make it there...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I... I must hurry... or I won't make it...!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Adnachiel... Steward... hang on just a little longer...!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Pardon me! Is there anyone here?!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I need a car! Is there anyone—

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Fotze! Do you know what time it is?! Who's knocking!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Ugh, my forehead—

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Little girl...? Are you okay?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I-I'm okay... You rent cars, right? I'm sorry for disrupting your sleep, but I need a car that can make it to the city right away!

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: It's five in the morning... What's the rush? It takes three to four hours to make it to the city from here.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: *Cough*... I... I have to leave right now. It's an emergency! Please, sir, give me a car right now! I really, really, really—

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Verdammt, what's so important you can't let me sleep?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: M-My friends' lives are in danger. I need to find a doctor in the city.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: They got in an accident in the mountain range to the north. They only got some simple treatment at the settlement there... I need to find a better medical organization to treat them right away!

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: You mean you came all the way here from the north?

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: You crossed the mountain range overnight? And the snowstorm hasn't even let up...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I didn't have another choice. *Cough*... They are heavily injured and can't move. The settlement doesn't have the proper medical equipment or medicine either...

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Did they trip or get frostbite? You could've just waited for the rescue team. Why did you have to cross the mountains yourself?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: No, normal EMTs won't do it... and we need medicine that can treat them...!

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: You aren't even explaining yourself clearly. How am I supposed to rent you a car right now?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Please, sir, I can't lose my friends... As long as there's still a bit of hope, I have to go to the city to find a doctor that can treat them! *Cough*... *Cough*...

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: *Sigh*... Must have been a long journey for you.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I-I'm fine...

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Okay, fine. This is their lives we're talking about. Come with me. Let me say one thing, though. Don't be too optimistic, girl. You won't necessarily find yourself a doctor out in the city.

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: The doctors there, with the kind of salary they get, won't risk heading into the snowstorm to treat somebody.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I was on the Bobsled Patrol Team back home. If you get me a car, I will find a doctor! I have some savings too. I can give the doctor everything as long as my friends get to live—

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: There has to be a doctor who's nice enough to come treat them. I will find them and beg them to come if I have to. I need to get my friends treated.

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Hmph... You're a loyal one.

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: I hope you find your doctor. Okay, here's the car. It's by the day. Do you have the deposit and documents?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Sorry, mister, I didn't expect this to happen, so I didn't bring much money. Is this enough for the deposit?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: If it's not enough, I... I have this necklace. It was a special birthday present. It should be worth some money...! Yeah, uh, and I... let's see...

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: It's all good. Keep your stinking necklace. Take the car. When you come back, I better see it in one piece.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Thank you, sir! I will be back on time! K-Keep my snowboard as collateral. Once I find a doctor, I'll come back before we head up the mountain!

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: *Sigh*... I don't know if this girl's simple or just reckless.

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Look at the shape the snowboard's in. That's hardly worth anything.

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Whatever. It's obvious she's trying to save somebody... Let's just call this doing a good deed.

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: But still...

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Hfff, it's so cold today, and it's pitch black outside. She even came straight here through the most dangerous mountain range there is... How did she do it?

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Just what is going on with her friends that she has to go all the way to the city to find a doctor? If they're hurt or got frostbite, there are much better ways to go about it.

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: It can't be something dangerous like Oripathy, right...?

steps.name: Transport Rental Salesman
steps.text: Hah, that'd be a waste of time. No one would help someone who's bound to die in this kind of shitty weather.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: (Okay, time to go.)

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: (The snowstorm's gotten stronger, but this is nothing. This won't stop me!)

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: (I gotta do it...)

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I... I didn't tell the truth.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: If I'd told him Adnachiel and Steward got infected with Oripathy, he wouldn't have let me borrow his car... He would've chased me away.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: But... I have to go. I'm so sorry, mister, but I'll come back to return the car for sure—No, I'll give you a new car. I'll work hard and pay you ten times the money back if I need to!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I will come back to apologize...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: But now...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Adnachiel, Steward, just hold on a little longer. I'll be at the city by sunrise.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I will bring a doctor who can treat Oripathy and medicine back... I promise.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I promise.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Merry... Have you made it to the city yet?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: *Pant*... You... you're awake...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Are you alright...?!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I'm... okay... Adnachiel, Steward, you... *cough*... Wait for me to come back. I'll find a doctor right away...!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: It's nearly impossible to find anyone who's infected in this city. You'll have to try a company or medical organization that does research in Oripathy.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I-I'll look it up... That's strange. How come there's so little information on this city?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: There's no hospitals here that accept Oripathy patients...? Only a few pharmaceutical companies in the outskirts?!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That's nothing strange... Leithanian cities don't really need that many medical organizations that deal in Oripathy.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oripathy is an incurable disease, and anyone who's so unlucky to be infected here has no choice but to spend a king's ransom on medication to slow down the spread of the disease.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Merry, you can't afford that medicine, and it's not something you should worry about either.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: If you find anyone who can take care of us, just tell us how to contact them. After that...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Yeah... You don't need to come back.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Thanks for dragging us all the way to the settlement. We got first aid... and that's more than enough.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: *Cough*... Adnachiel and I will figure out how to survive. Thanks for leaving us the comms, but let's put an end to this, Merry.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: What... What are you two talking about?!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I'm looking for a doctor to come treat you two right now. Just hold on! I'll be back with a doctor soon!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Adnachiel, Steward, wait for me. Don't just leave... and protect yourselves. Don't let your wounds get any worse.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: No buts! You hear me?!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Yeah... I hear you loud and clear.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: That's not enough! Promise me you won't leave me! I can do it! I will save you two!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Merry, thanks for looking after us, but we can't drag you into this mess...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: We're friends! Friends are supposed to help each other out! And given the circumstances, your lives are more important to me than anything!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Dammit! I don't want to get mad at you right now, but I will make you two pay for what you just said! Wait for my next call. I'll have some good news!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Hah... Those idiots. How dare they try to leave me all by myself... Where can they go anyway?! I better find them waiting for me!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I'll head to the aid station first. I trucked my way here all night. What's two more kilometers...? Right, I've got to call the hospital too...
*Dialing sounds*

steps.name: Regular Hospital Worker
steps.text: You've reached the emergency room hotline. How may I help you?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Oh, hello, I have two friends who were injured in the snowstorm out in the countryside. They need medical attention right now...

steps.name: Regular Hospital Worker
steps.text: Okay, just a moment...

steps.name: Regular Hospital Worker
steps.text: I'm very sorry, but we have to wait until the storm lets up before we can send an ambulance. Can you describe to me how they were injured?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: They got hurt in the mountains. One of them is really hurt in the abdomen and leg areas... Also, they have Oripathy, so they will need Oripathy medication...

steps.name: Regular Hospital Worker
steps.text: Did you say Oripathy...?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Yeah, they...

steps.name: Regular Hospital Worker
steps.text: Sorry, but our hospital does not accept Oripathy patients. Thank you for your call. I wish you a pleasant day.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Hello? Hello??

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: They hung up...? Why did they hang up? Didn't their website say they treat Oripathy?! Dammit, are there any medical companies here that treat Oripathy...?
*Dialing sounds*

steps.name: Medical Company Staff
steps.text: Hello. How may I help you?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Hello, is this Leithanien Woche Pharmaceuticals? M-My name is Merry. My friends are infected with Oripathy, and they need treatment right now...

steps.name: Medical Company Staff
steps.text: May I have your name? And where do you live?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: U-Uh... my name? I'm from the north...

steps.name: Medical Company Staff
steps.text: You're not a local...? What about the patients?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: M-My friends are from Laterano and Kjerag. They came to Leithanien during their travels. I left them at a settlement in the mountains outside the city...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Hello...? Hello? Dammit! Why did they hang up?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Is Oripathy really so scary that you can't get treatment if you're not a local or noble?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: *Sobs*... I-I'll try another one...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Hello, my friends are infected with Oripathy and need treatment. They are seriously hurt...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Huh...? Them? They are normal travelers, but we won't fall behind on the fees for their treatment and medicine. I promise! I-I can even pay extra—

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: If you can send a doctor to come with me right now—

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: A doctor...! Is there a doctor who can treat Oripathy patients? This isn't a prank! I've got sick friends...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Why...? How come there isn't a single medical organization that's willing to help? Adnachiel, Steward... They're both sick. They need treatment!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Why do they have to ask, 'Which family are the patients from?' Are common folks not allowed to get treatment?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I already told them we can pay up, but they still wouldn't take us... Why...?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Is it because they have Oripathy? Isn't that just a kind of disease? They got sick, that's all. They didn't want to be infected...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Why doesn't anyone want to help now that they are Infected?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: No... I can't give up yet... There are still three more... There has to be someone willing to help!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Merry? Can you hear me...? Are you still mad?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Listen to me. This is not something that the three of us can change.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Adnachiel's fever has gone down a little. He's getting some good sleep now. We need to cool our heads and figure out where we go from here.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: We don't know if Oripathy is infectious under these circumstances.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: This is a very dangerous disease... and you may get caught in the mess. If there really is no way, don't come back for us.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Also...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: If... If you can't find a doctor who's willing to come, we understand.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: The mountains are too dangerous during a snowstorm. Doctors are people too, and the medical organizations need to be responsible to their doctors, Merry. We can't blame them.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: We're very grateful, Merry. Adnachiel and I know how you feel, and you are our friend. But because you're our friend, we don't want anything to happen to you.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Stop acting so tough, and don't put your future on the line. Stay in the city until it's safe.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Give us a call once you get this, Merry.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: No, I don't want to hear any of that...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I know. Of course I know, but... but I...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: T-There's two left... They only have five employees, but...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Guh... I'm going for it!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Hello! Is this the liaison office of... uh... 'Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals?'

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Uh... Yes! May I help you?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Um... My name is Merry. I'm from northern Leithanien... I-I guess I'm kind of a noble? I've got a pretty big family, and our neighbors love us.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I didn't bring my passbook with me, but I have this much in the bank... I-I can even work. I definitely won't owe any money for the medical fees!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hmm...? Um... Excuse me...?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: *Cough*... *Whimpers*, I'm sorry! I'm sorry I lied! I'm not a noble, and I don't have anywhere close to this much in the bank, but I will really work to pay for the treatment!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I have two friends with Oripathy. Please don't turn them down just because they are foreigners. They are heavily injured, and their lives are in danger. I really need someone to help them...!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Heavily injured Infected? Where are they?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: At a settlement in the mountains. I left them there for the time being.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Please! Please come with me. It may be a little dangerous to travel there, but I promise! I promise I will keep the doctors safe even if I have to protect them with my life!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I'll do something about the medical fees too! Please just help them first...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Please, I beg you... Help my friends...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You don't have to say that. Don't... swear on your life.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's Rhodes Island's mission to help the Infected, Miss Merry.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We will go with you. Could you tell us how the Infected are doing?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Y-You will...?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Yes, we'll leave right away. Are they still in the early stages of their infection? If they are, then we mustn't wait. That's the best time to treat Oripathy.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I have their coordinates. I'll send them to you right away!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Oh, but... There's a snowstorm out in the countryside right now... We need to be prepared...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Relax. Rhodes Island has transport suitable for all kinds of weather, and also have experienced operators who can guarantee our safety during the trip. We'll make it there even in the harshest weather and most dangerous places.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Really?! That's so nice... I-Is this real?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I mean... I'm not too cold, am I? I-I can't feel my legs... Am I dreaming...?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: *Sigh*... Looks like you need treatment yourself. Miss Merry, can you reach the patients right now?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: It's not a dream... It's not a dream!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I'll give them a call right now!

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Hey, Adnachiel, Steward, can you hear me?! Stay right where you are! Rhodes Island and I are coming to help you right now... I've found them...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I mean... I've really found a way to help my friends...!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: All preparations complete. Rhodes Island Critical Response Team is ready for deployment.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Miss Merry, are you okay?

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Uhh... I'm fine... I'll lead the way...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh, don't move... You're very weak... You must've spent way too much time on the road.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We'll head to the coordinates' right now, but it'll take us seven to eight hours, even if the weather gets better.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Uhh... No way... It only took me five hours to get here...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Five hours?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: That was way too reckless! You... *Sigh*...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: I need to return the car... to the rental shop... Sir... I'm sorry... Thanks...

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Then... Adnach... Stew...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: She's starting to blabber nonsense...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Get some rest, Miss Merry. You've done really well.

steps.name: Merry
steps.text: Zzz... zzz...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'll drive. The patients are waiting, and we need to head there ASAP. Is she sitting on the passenger side?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: No, I need to take her in the med vehicle and treat her there.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: She's got frostbite, multiple scrapes, and sprained joints. From the looks of it... she might even have a few broken bones. It's a miracle she held on for so long.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Five hours... That's way too reckless. How could she have made her way down such a treacherous path during a snowstorm...?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: She's tough. If she managed to come all the way here that fast, she might just be the kind of operator we need.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: And I heard her mumbling. She said she wanted to save her friends, right? That's some temperament she's got.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's rash! She's just lucky, and she may not be as lucky next time! Seriously, if she was one of ours, the instructors would definitely be tearing her a new one.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: But fine... It's too early to talk about all this. Our top priority right now is to rescue her friends. As for Miss Merry herself...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We'll have them walk us through everything she and her friends have been through after they all make it out safe.
